page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Centred lines of title text from top to bottom; a woodcut ornament in the middle; imprint lines below the woodcut. A handwritten number in the top right corner is not printed.

main_text.l: Papa, ejus imperium, totusque Missæ, Religionis & Ecclesiæ Romanæ apparatus, una ruinâ concidere debent.

l.i: Neque me, ut miretur turba laboro

page.notes: The page number 163 is handwritten in the top right corner, not printed; it is given above only as the scan's visible number. The woodcut ornament is an engraved device between the motto and the imprint, with no text. The title is set in large capitals, with mixed roman and italic lines. "totus-que" is a line-end break printed with a hyphen: "totus-" / "queMissæ" as printed, where "queMissæ" appears to have lost its space in print. Marks and specks in the scan are not text.
